program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define after-rows
      (for/fold ([out g]) ([r (in-range (rows g))])
        (let ((cols1 (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 1)) (range 0 (cols g)))))
          (foldl (lambda (pair acc)
                   (let ((c1 (first pair)) (c2 (second pair)))
                     (if (and (> (- c2 c1) 1)
                              (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 0)) (range (+ c1 1) c2)))
                         (paint-cells acc (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range c1 (+ c2 1))) 2)
                         acc)))
                 out (pairs cols1)))))
    (for/fold ([out after-rows]) ([c (in-range (cols g))])
      (let ((rows1 (filter (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 1)) (range 0 (rows g)))))
        (foldl (lambda (pair acc)
                 (let ((r1 (first pair)) (r2 (second pair)))
                   (if (and (> (- r2 r1) 1)
                            (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 0)) (range (+ r1 1) r2)))
                       (paint-cells acc (map (lambda (r) (list r c)) (range r1 (+ r2 1))) 2)
                       acc)))
               out (pairs rows1))))))
